name: AGIS AI Chat
author: agismack

sections.description:
Welcome to AGIS AI Chat, your next generation artificial intelligent agent for interacting with your visitors. AGIS AI Chat instantly brings your visitors in touch with an AI expert who can answer in-depth questions about every aspect of your website. Try it for free and be amazed at how accurate, timely, informed your new chat client can be.

External Services and Data Usage
The Agis.ai WordPress Plugin relies on certain external scripts hosted on our servers (prod.agis.ai and agis.ai). These scripts are integral to the functionality of the plugin but are not third-party services. Instead, they are hosted by Agis.ai to ensure streamlined updates and consistency across platforms. Below is a detailed breakdown of these files, their purpose, and how they interact with the plugin.

Hosted JavaScript Files and APIs:
https://prod.agis.ai:9081/api/talk
Purpose: This is the primary entry point for our Agis.ai chat system. It handles all communication between the plugin and the Agis.ai server to generate AI-powered responses.
Function: Facilitates real-time AI-powered conversations within the WordPress environment.

https://prod.agis.ai:9081/api/
Purpose: This is the general API collection endpoint used by the plugin for all AI-related activities.
Function: Manages various AI tasks including chatbot functionalities and other features accessed via the plugin.

https://www.agis.ai/agisInstall/agis.js
Purpose: This JavaScript file contains the core code required to create and embed the Agis.ai chat client within the user’s browser.
Function: Provides the front-end chat interface for users interacting with the Agis.ai system.

https://prod.agis.ai/agis_admin/iframes/agis_sites.js
Purpose: Generates the user’s dashboard for managing their Agis.ai settings. This is displayed when users are logged into WordPress or via the Agis.ai backend (accessible through the “My Account” section).
Function: Enables users to configure their AI settings and view chat statistics from within WordPress or the Agis.ai platform.

Legal Considerations and Transparency
These scripts and APIs are hosted by Agis.ai and are not third-party services. They are used to enhance the performance of the plugin and provide core functionality.
For your reference, our Terms of Service and Privacy Policy outline how data transmitted through these APIs is processed and protected. We do not sell user data, and all information is used strictly to improve our services.
We ensure that all data sent to our servers is encrypted and processed securely.
By hosting these scripts on our own servers, we are able to provide faster and more efficient updates across platforms without requiring additional actions from users.

TOS: You can find our Terms of Service here: https://www.agis.ai/terms-of-service

sections.installation:
1. Upload agis-ai-chat.php to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
  3. Place <?php do_action('plugin_name_hook'); ?> in your templates
sections.faq:
How much does this cost?

We have a free tier that can be used.

Is the chat specific to my own website?

Our proprietary technology means that each chat installation is specific to your individual website. Questions asked in chat will be answered using information from your own site.
